title: Mike Ditka, Hall of Fame tight end and coach of the 1985 Bears, dies at 86
dek: His family announced the death on Friday morning. Fans, reporters and the NFL are marking it.
what: Mike Ditka's family announced his death on Friday 9 October, the Associated Press reports. He was 86. A Chicago sports station was the first captured post to say so, and the reporter Adam Schefter followed with the family announcement.

Ditka played tight end and was the first tight end inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, Schefter's follow-up says. He coached the Chicago Bears from 1982 to 1992, and his 1985 team won Super Bowl XX. The NFL called him a Hall of Fame coach and tight end in a statement of sympathy.
The family statement, as reported, called him "the heart of our family". I did not read a cause of death in any source and do not state one.
why: He was one of the best known figures in American football and in Chicago, and fans and teams are marking it.
